after.Name: The Moonstone Twin (level 45)
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Brigit will send you to Maudalin who lives at the top of the tower on the road to Caille. He tells you to seek the Tree Fairie near the edge of Bri Leith and Cursed Forest (16k/20k) who says you must kill Cadoc who runs with his enchanted horses during the day and night along the river from end to end. The horses are neutral and there are two sets: dark steeds at night and veil steeds during the day. Kill both sets and Cadoc will appear. Kill him and he gives you the second half-moonstone. Return this to Brigit for the second reward which is an Enchanter's Jewel.
Cadoc is on west side of river at far south end.
*Note:

I did this with my bard and killed both day and night steeds, which worked fine (if in a grp). With my champ at lvl 45 I noticed in the journal that you first have to do the day steeds and the text says to leave them alone, just follow. I solo folowed them to the end of the river where I just talked to a friendly Cadoc. This got me the day step. The night step I'm afraid is a violent one...
Rewards:
Enchanter's Jewel
Nightshade Jewel
Champion's Jewel
Bard's Jewel

after.Name: The Moonstone Twin (level 47)
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-28 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Next Brigit sends you to kill a banshee named Rioldna who roams in the water northwest of Alainn Binn. After you kill her and get the first stone, the Faerie Queen appears momentarily and sends you to the healer in Alainn Binn (Ceri), who says you must kill the Faerie Queen in Cursed Forest (night only, east side of the river at 50k/25k). Kill the three maidens to get the Queen to spawn. Kill her maidens first, then kill her to get the second stone. Before she dies, she sends you to free the steed that is being held captive by the far dorochas.
To Find Banshee Rioldna, head to Alainn Binn in far South-East corner of Bog of Cullen and go West-SouthWest to /loc= 44200,52400
I believe it is a night time only spawn. Mentioned in another posting is midnight - 6:00am, I found her at 2:30am
Once you see the apparition of the Faerie Queen, head back into Alainn Binn the north hut and see the healer Ceri.
Target Healer Ceri and type "/say Apparition" and then "/say Faerie Queen".

after.Name: A War of Old
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: At 20th, go back to Morlin. He will tell you that Masrim has heard of more Albion undead, and to go talk to her. She will mention Lieutenant Salurn, and send you to talk to Barkeep Yseniver in Galplen. She will tell you that Salurn and his band of armsmen have been raiding southern Myrkwood, and ask you to go kill him.

If you follow the southeast road from Galplen, then keep going southeast when the road turns, you'll hit the zone wall fairly shortly. Follow the zone wall south, dodge the big svartalf camp, and Salurn will be on a hill just past the svartalfs (loc 60.7, 63.2). He is blue at 20th, and his companions are grey. Kill him, and return to Barkeep Yseniver, who will send you back to Masrim. The reward for this step is Forest Hunter's Boots (Hunter) or Shadowed Leggings (Shadowblade).
Rewards:
Shadowed Leggings
Forest Hunter's Boots

after.Name: A War of Old
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: For 25th, go to the barkeep in Galplen and she will ask you to kill to kill a witch in Skona Ravine.
Go west out of Gna Faste, West past the Werewolf fort and into Skona.
In Skona, hug the northern wall and travel west. About 4/5th the way across the zone, you get to a cliff overlooking a lake.
Stay on top of the cliff, but turn SE and follow the edge of the cliff/hill.
The witch should be a 30 second walk that direction standing under a tree (loc= 20.5k, 9k). She cons blue to a lvl26.
Kill her , then go back to the barkeep in Galplen and show her the book you get from the witch, and she'll send you back to Masrim in Ft. Alta.
Rewards:
Forest Hunter's Vest -- Hunter
Shadowed Vest -- Shadowblade
Rewards:
Forest Hunter's Vest
Shadowed Vest

after.Name: A War of Old
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Return to Morlin Caan (smith in Jord). He tells you to speak to Masrim (Ft.
Atla). She tells you of Pellinistra, a Werewolf in Skona that you must
kill.
Pellinistra is located in the southeast section of skona. Location is 52k
by 52k. From the Standing Stones travel South until you pass the second
deep ravine. Pellinistra is located atop a small hill with a tent on it on
the south side of the ravine. There are several other WW there that con
gray and green to me at level 30. I pulled Pellinistra from the Southwest
side of the hill.
Pellinistra is blue, a green WW added when I pulled Pellinistra. I had a
level 20 tingler with me to occupy the green Werewolf while I killed
Pellinistra. I then finished off the green. Pellinistra drops a wand.
After you kill Pellinistra, return to Masrim in Ft. Atla and give her
Pellinistra's wand. She sends you back to Morlin Caan who gives you the
Heart-piercer Bow (Hunter) or a Moonshadow Cloak (Shadowblade)
Rewards:
Moonshadow Cloak
Heart-piercer Bow

after.Name: An End to the Daggers
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I finished the An End to the Daggers, and went straight into the 45 part, as I am level 46 at this time. I had to go into Jord to find AUDUN a drunk dwarf in the pub [just click on any guard and type, /Where Audun ].

I /say to him that "Lynnleigh sent me", and give him the Map. He tells me to help him find his Sister in Vanern Swamp, and get her out of the Skeithkona clan. The next part is what I have in my journal now:
Step 15. "Seek Arica (the sister) and Mista (the bad influence, aprox. loc 62k, 60k) in Vanern Swamp, near Skona Ravine. Deal with the Evil being spread by the two women and their Skiethkona."
I found the two sisters, red con w/4 yellow adds, but I had a group with me, so no problem... forgot the /loc but it's right on the border of Vanern Swamp after you pass from Skona to Vanern.
After I killed them, ARICA told me to give her brother a note, which appeared in my backpack.
Returned to Jord, saw AUDUN again, and gave him the note.
He took the note, and then helped me with the Map.

He told me that I had to go see Lynnleigh again, so I went to see her. She told me that there was a Red Dagger that wanted to get the Tome from Elizabeth the Enchanter, and that I should get stronger before continuing on my journey.
I recieved a "Crystlized Musical Note" (jewel slot).
aprox. experience of 876,609,536
3 gold and some silver

Got 1,363,657,152 experience.

after.Name: Feast of the Decadent
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-04 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Here is a guide to the Defenders' of Albion epic quest Feast of the Decadent Part 2 for those who reach Level 45.

1. Return to Elvinia Dareal at Caer Witrin. She asks you to kill two foci that are disrupting the bwcas and gives you a scroll to take to a female NPC in Snowdonia Fortress after you have killed the first focus.

The first focus is named Dathmul (Loc=49k,25k in Snowdonia, New Frontiers loc=7916,3083,7872). He is a named hollow man that spawns north by northeast of Caer Hurbury in Snowdonia. He was a red con at 45 so bring a friend or two. There were no adds even though I had two level 50 guildmates grouped with me. He was already there, so if he is not killing hollow men will probably not make him spawn.

2. Return to Snowdonia Fortress and give the scroll to the Vera Astyrian. She reads from the scroll and determines the second focus is the Wizard Lichas in Stonehenge Barrows. You are asked to seek and destroy him and then see Arly Camden in Castle Sauvage.

3. Once you enter Barrows head west past the decayed zombies. Continue down the hallway until you must turn right (north), and then turn left(west) into the room with the phantoms in it. Turn right (north) immediately while staying close to the wall to avoid aggro. Go straight north into the corridor. You will be looking into the room where Lichas spawns. He spawns on top of the big boulder or whatever in the middle of the room. He was orange con to 45 and casts some mean fireballs. With two level 50's in group we got one add.

4. Next see Arly Camden at Castle Sauvage. He praises you and deems you worthy of a reward. He gives you a level 47 magical cloak based on your class and asks you to return later (Level 48). At 45 I was rewarded with a bubble of experience along with the cloak.
Rewards:
Cloak of the Stalwart Arm -- Armsman
Cape of Vigilant Defense -- Scout
Shielding Dweomer -- Theurgist
Prayer Bound Vestments -- Friar

after.Name: Feast of the Decadent
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1. Return to Arly Camden in Castle Sauvage. He tells you about a new, more powerful bwca that has spawned in Snowdonia. You are instructed to kill the enraged bwca and bring back a token of its demise.

This is the easiest way to reach the enraged bwca. From Snowdonia Fortress, go to Caer Hurbury. From Hurbury head straight west until you reach the guard tower. Follow the road from the tower north. There is a camp of angry bwcas off to the right of the road. This is the first spot to check (/loc = 20, 12). Kill a few angry bwcas and the enraged bwca should spawn on the camp fire.

If not, move onto spot #2. I found the enraged bwca straight southwest of the first location. He was there right way among the angry bwcas. He conned orange at 49 so bring a friend or two. Kill him and you receive an enraged bwca hide. Return to Arly Camden in Castle Sauvage.

2. Once you have given the hide to Arly, he tells you to see Vera Astyrian in Snowdonia Fortress. Vera tells you about a named cyhraeth, Soulfear (loc 49/52 in Snowdonia, New Frontiers loc=56k 19k), who is guiding the cyhraeth and causing the bwcas to become more fierce. You are instructed to slay her. Once again leave Snowdonia Fortress headed towards Hurbury. However, this time veer off to the right (south) of the road toward the lake. The cyhraeth and Soulfear spawn on the northern shore. I counted 2 cyhraeth and Soulfear. She conned red to me at 49, but the others were orange. We pulled the others first and killed them pretty easily (me, a 50 scout, and 50 cleric). Soulfear was a piece of cake. You receive the Scrolls of Fate from Soulfear and are told to speed them to your trainer in
Camelot.

3. Once you give the Scrolls of Fate to your trainer, he/she hands them back and tells you to take them to Lidmann Halsley at the tower guarding Adribard's Retreat in Avalon Marsh. Lidmann tells you he needs to study the scrolls more and to return at Level 50 when he is finished.
You only receive experience for this quest, no items. I received .8 of a bubble at 49 from this quest (.25 from the trainer and .55 from
Lidmann). I also got .1 from killing all the angry bwcas.
The second loc is 7k,30k.

after.Name: Guild Introduction
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Master Reginald says, "Ah, Rogue, soon you must choose which professioin to follow. There are a couple of choices, but not all are open to you. I suggest you speak to the trainers that will accept you, before you make your decison."
Dialog box: Will you go and meet the trainers who are interested in your skills?
You have been given the Guild Introduction quest.
Master Reginald says, "Smart choice! Speak to Lietenant Newster. The professoin of Scout, in the Defenders of Albion, is open to you."
[Step #1] Speak to Lieutenant Newster about life as a Scout and the Defenders of Albion.

Lieutenant Newster says, "So you wish to learn about life as a Scout, eh? Well, we are part of the Defenders of Albion. Your bow, that should be your main choice for weapons. You do your best work at a distance, as a Scout, and should be the [first line] of offense."

Lieutenant Newster says, "Certainly. It is not only here in the Isle of Glass that your skills as a Scout will be sought after. Back in Albion, in the frontier lands, our enemies seek to overtake the realm. It is something you should [consider]."
Lieutenant Newster says, "Yes, but don't make any hasty decisions. You should speak to Elaru, with the Guild of Shadows, to learn of life as an Infiltrator."
[Step #2] Speak with Elaru about life as an Infiltrator and the Guild of Shadows.

Elaru says, "Ah, you wish to learn of life as an Infiltrator in the Guild of Shadows. Yes. The Guild of Shadows also has welcomed the Temple of Arawn into it's halls. As an Infiltrator, you will serve the Guild of Shadows. [Stealth] will be your greatest friend."

Elaru says, "Yes, and twilight your sawn, for the work of an infiltrator is best accomplished when the sky is darkened and the land asleep. You will be sent to the enemy's arms. and expected to return successfully. [Death] is the only excuse for failing."
Elaru says, "Consider your choices when the time comes. Think well what Arawn would wish for you."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 88 experience!
You have finished the Guild Introduction quest.

after.Name: Information is the Key
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your path on this quest depends on your race, talk you your trainer for details.
Your trainer talks about "treasure of the past" and then asks if you will

research information about the Moonstone. You are told to talk to Maeve. Maeve (a firbolg known better as Maeve the Crone) lives in a hut a little way past Ardee. When you get to the town (from Mag Mell) go a little to the right and follow along near the base of the hills till you see a hut by the river near some mudmen houses. Maeve is inside the hut, and usually the mudmen are neutral so you can talk to her. She wants you to collect some items for her.
Maeve the crone says, "What brings you out this far? Shouldn't you be training at your Master's knee child? Or do you think to connive [knowledge] out of me?

Maeve the crone says, "Aye. I thought so. Well, an old woman like me can't survive long on her own, being to old to practice the trade of my youth. Knowledge is my only trade now. The price is four rat tails."
[Step #2]Kill four rat boys and bring their tails to Maeve for information
on Caithor.
[Step#3]Kill three more rat boys.
[Step#4]Kill two more rat boys.
[Step#5]Kill one more rat boy.
[Step#6]Return to Maeve with rat tails. She knows about Caithor.
Return the items, and she gives you a choice of several topics, but you can only choose one!
[Step#7] Give Maeve the tails.
Maeve, the crone says, "Have you the rat tails?"
You give Maeve the crone a rat tail.
Maeve the crone says, "I need three more. Stay away from the ruins of the
Tower of Tir na mBeo. Its a place of powerful enchantment."
You give Maeve the crone a rat tail.
Maeve the crone says, "Two more ought to do it. Remember Eadienn, Fagan
is Lord over Mag Mell, but the town's concerns arn't his. Some say he's the
same Fagan of Fagan's feast."
You give Maeve the crone a rat tail.
Maeve the crone says, "One more, and I'll tell you what I know."
You give Maeve the crone a rat tail.
Maeve the crone says, "Yes, this will do. I shall tell you one more thing
only. Which would you hear of, [Caithor], [Duana and Edan] or [the Moonstone]?"
*Caithor:

Maeve the crone says, "Caithor is the Champion responsible for the enchantment placed on Edan. Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment on Caithor. For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well.
*the Moonstone:
Maeve, the crone says,"Ah, the Moonstone. It's a stone wielded by an
Enchanter, and the only thing that can break the enchantment placed on Duana
and Edan. It is here, in these lands. But none know where."
*Duana and Edan

Maeve, the crone says,"Duana and Edan are the hounds that roam the ground of the ruined Tower of Tir na mBeo. In a time only the elders remember, Fagan held a feast, Edan asked for Duana. Against Fagan's wishes, she said yes. Fagan was enraged, but his geas strickly forbid him from killing the son of a man he had killed. He had his Champion find a way to remove Edan without killing him. Caithor challenged the bard Edan for Duana knowinf Edan would easily die on his blade. To prevent his death and Fagan breaking his geas, he made an ointment and rubbed it on his sword. The first strike hit Edan, and slowly, he was changed into a hound."
You have finished the Information is the Key quest.
You are awarded experience!

Lines: This is Part I of an epic quest, and it includes nesting quests: (The nested quests included in this one are Wizard Lost and Barbaric Tales.)
Per Patch 1.53:

Legend of the Lake: We have made some changes to the 15th level portion of this quest in an attempt to bring it up to the level of other quests within the realm. The main change is the addition of two sub-quests to complement the existing "Barbaric Tales" and "Wizard Lost". Players who encounter this step of the quest will be given the option to perform two of the possible four sub-quests. Please note that these changes will not affect players that have already performed this section of the quest. One of these new quests is Lisreen's Plight.
1. Talk to your trainer. He will tell you that they need to find Excaliber.
2.The first step is to locate the Lady of the Lake. Your journal notes will tell you she can be found at night, either in Snowdonia, Camp. Forest, or the Avalon Marsh.

Through a little research you will find out her name is Lady Nimue. I found her in the lake southeast of Caer Witrin. To get there from Caer Witrin, follow the path leading towards Adribard's Retreat (To the east) and you shall come to a dark grey stone bridge. Do not cross the bridge, instead, turn right along the shoreline and follow it. You shall see a large playground-looking fort, which is actually full of bogmen. She is in between two islands, one with the playground, the other with a bridge connected to the playground island. Swim towards the point where the bridge meets the right-hand island. loc=27631,45026 You will see Lady Nimue standing in the water after you have swam out a little way, she cannot be seen from the shore. She pops from 7pm-5am. (Lady Nimue can be found in Campa Forest during the day at 8380, 47321, and Avalon Marsh during night at 27631, 45026.)
She will then give you a quest called Wizard Lost, something about the wizard Merlin and the Wisdom of Legends, complete it then continue with Legend of the Lake.
3. She will tell you something about the Tome of Legends, and Sir Verin. This is the beginning of a mini-quest called Barbaric Tales.
You can ONLY DO TWO of the four sub-quests, be careful which ones you choose. But it has been said that you actually can do all 4 subquests. You only have to do 2 of them through Nimue.
4. After you complete the two subquests, go visit the mobs that give out the other two quests and you'll be able to do them.

Sleeves of the Stoic -- Armsman
Necklace of Elemental Influence -- Theurgist
Gauntlets of Archery -- Scout

after.Name: Occupation of Lough Gur
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Aziliz (located on the isle across from Tir na mBeo and Argagh) asks you
to investigate the gurite occupation. She sends you to see Solas in Shannon
Estuary near the Ceanlia village.
Solas requires the head of a curm fighter before he will speak to you.
Seek out curm fighters either in Lough Derg or near Innis Carthaig along
the shore of the lake.
Once Solas receives the head, he speaks a few things about the gurites
but Trefor in the gurite raider camp will have more for you. However, he
will want two druid daggers. Trefor loc: 6k 53k on the west side of Lough
Gur. Druids can be found on a hill in Bri Leith or the west side of Lough
Gur.
Upon delivering the daggers to Trefor, he will ask you to retrieve a treasure
from a named cluracaun, Smirky. His loc is 31k 18k. You may find him
at night but possibly have to kill a few regular cluricauns to get him to
spawn. Killing Smirky gets you a "smirky's ring."
Deliver smirky's ring to Trefor. He doesn't detect anything special with the
ring and brushes you off. He gives you the ring back while doing so.
Return to Aziliz and speak to her. Give her the ring. She begins to study
it and asks you to tell Trefor that you "would like to do more treasure
hunting."
After stating that to Trefor, he sends you to Iago (right across the fire
from Trefor). Iago has a plan that involves a special named curm, Curmie.
His loc is 49k 29k near Innis. He gives you a sack of rotting fish in order to lure Curmie out.
Give Curmie the rotting fish. In the process, Curmie somehow dies. You
may be jumped by some lower level curms (fighters, poachers, etc). Iago
appears and exclaims that you are apparently of no use and states you
should find your own way home.
Return to Aziliz and state that the gurites "search for treasure of the lost tower of tir na mbeo." She states in the process that the ring was lost
long ago and was overlooked by the gurites of its value. She rewards
you with a decent amount of exp some gold and an item.
Rewards:
Gramail Bann -- Nightshade and Ranger
Comas Bann -- Druid
Luth Bann -- Blademaster, Champion, Hero, and Warden
Brigh Bann -- Eldritch,Enchanter, and Mentalist

Trefor: Orange to level 24, 6.6k 53k
Iago: Red to level 24, 6.6k 53k
Smirky: Yellow to level 24, 31k 18k
Smidget: Yellow to level 24, 31k 18k (no special loot dropped)
Curmie: Orange to level 24, 49k 29k
Rewards:
Gramail Bann
Comas Bann
Luth Bann
Bard's Bann
Brigh Bann

after.Name: Passage to Eternity
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Get this quest form your trainer.

[Step #8] The Church believes the cyhreath of the Pennie Mountains may be involved with the evil that led members away from the light of Camelot. Seek out these cyhreath and slay one. Do not tarry as the Church has yet another task for you to perform.
Kill one Cyhreath at Pennie Mountains (New Frontiers Cyhraeth can be found northeast of Caer Hurbury at loc 53.8K, 22.5K)
[Step #9] Speak to Mistress Ainsliee at the Snowdonia border keep.

[Step #10] Find and slay the Sockburn worm. Legend has it that the worm resides underground and rises only at certain times of the day. Sightings of the worm have benn located just north and east of Caer Berkstead within the Pennie Mountains.

Sockburn worm at 29k, 27k ( near 30k 26k you get a meassage of "the ground below you shifts slightly")(New Frontiers loc=16k / 46k in Pennine). Kill it. It pop at afternoon, about 55 level. You will get a wormtooth. It was purple to me at 47, and there were no adds, though you might want to be sure to pull back far enough so you don't get jumped by any worms that wander by.
[Step #11] Return the wormtooth to your trainer in Camelot. I got 1,881,701,916 experience when I turned in the wormtooth to my trainer in Camelot, about one full bub at level 47.
You will get a lot of XP(0.8 at lvl 47) and a level 47 cloak, "Cloak of Defiant Soul" for cleric.
Rewards:
Cloak of Defiant Soul
Cape of the Iron Will

Lines: See your trainer in Camelot.
(step #11-#13 here ? only running and talking so you can write that you will have to travel a bit: Camelot, CS, Snowdonia only I think... )
step #14. See Bertie Dracon in Swanton Keep.
step #15. Go to Mistress Ainsliee in Snowdonia Fortress.
step #16. Find Eye of Arawn in Snowdonia. This is an easy cyclop - I think it was yellow to 49. It is located at 57, 15. (New Frontiers loc is 48.7k, 42.3k SE of Caer Hurb)
step #17. Return to Mistress Ainsliee in Snowdonia Fortress.
step #18. Travel to Magess Axton in Lethantis Association in Camp.Forest
step #19. See Aclee Marlow at the top of tower in Cear Ulfwych in Camp.Forest - you will get ring.
step #20. Give Aclee's ring to Gram Nechten in Castle Sauvage.

step #21. Kill Blue Man and search for glyph in his tower-like cave. It is giant located south of Caer Berkstead at 20, 45 in Pennine Mts. Orange con at level 50. You will have to kill his giant companion inside the room as well. Enter the room and stay inside. You will continue to receive "searching" messages until you eventually receive the Glyph. [Step #8 - continuation of level 25 quest] Return to Captain Rhodri when you have achieved level 30.

Scribe Veral says, "Yes! There is news that Bors is a target for assassination. The report does not specify who will attempt the deed, only that it will be attempted soon. I will take your case before King Constantine, but you must return with haste, and assist in thwarting this treachery!"

Lines: This quest is the 3rd installment of the Red Dagger quest.
It starts by speaking to Lynnleigh on the island near Vasudheim.
She speaks to you about the [Thane's blood]. Get used to that name, you'll be typing it a lot. She then asks you to go and speak to ALL the smiths of Midgard to learn about the Thane's Blood.

Of course, you want to start at the smith in Haggerfel, Genlu Edrill. Since you've spoken with him earlier, he remembers you when you asking about [Thane's Blood], and tells you to try Kol Smithir, the smith in Huginfell.
Kol is tired of talking about the legend, and tells you to go talk to the smith in Audliten. His name is Dahn, and he believes in the Thane's Blood.

He says he will help you, and then says he cannot tell you where the axe you seek is, but he can help you fashion a container to hold the Thane's Blood. He says he requires three items, all from Yggdra Forest:
the soul of a Cold Light
the Chiseler's venom
the skin of a Flurry ( found around loc 52676, 43569 in Uppland. Also found at loc 53640 43000 near the base of the tree)

When you give the items to him, he tells you to go to the Gythja of Bragi and "curtsey all nice like" and tell her that "the Thane's Blood flows from many hands".
After you do this, she gives you a reward and will tell you to return to her when you have gotten stronger (level 30 or so).

Lines: The Epic for these for classes starts at level 43 and is called Unnatural Powers, when you train with (Master Ranger Trainer in TnN was who I saw) your trainer.
He or she will tell you to talk to Lovernios, the Druid Prince in the garden behind the vault room in TnN.

He will tell you his story line & then tell you to go see & talk to Ide (loc 52k x 46k) a named Fruadan Draoi (not on beastiary list?) in the Bog of Cullen, go just a little north of Allian Bin to find her among others of her type (which are Dark Druids). She will tell you her story line.

Then you have find Saemus (loc 21k x 25k not on beastiary list either) he moves around some, but in the water all the time I was there) and kill him to get his Crystal. Seamus is around level 50 (red at 43) but not that hard to kill, bring a friend or 2 to be safe and watch out if Siabias have you on their kill on site list, lol which Im on.

Once you kill Saemus return to Lovernios & give him Seamuss Crystal, in return, after he tells his story line, he gives you 12 gold plus, almost 1.1 billion exp (about bubble and a quarter to me) along with a Emerald Threaded Forest Cloak usable by Ranger and then tells you to talk to Torrance when you are ready (for level 47, you get jewel when its completed) hes at the tower on the road to Innis Carthaig (across from Connla). For level 50 you get a full set of Epic armor, all 6 items at once so have room in storage.
Here is some more information on this quest, submitted by Diko 50 Battledruid Bedevere:
1. Speak to Lovernios in the castle, out back in the garden (head towards the vault the you'll see the opening same person you get the Seeking Glory quest.

2. Ask Ide about the [dark magic] that corrupted her friend. She can be found with the other Fruadan Draoi, in the Bog of Cullen. (just north of Allainn Binn at the rock on the road) just tell her "dark magic"
3. Find Saemus and retrieve the crystal, He roams the Bog of Cullen. (21k, 25k) neutral and we killed him orange con to 50.
4. Bring the crystal to Lovernios, so the Druid Court may study it. (Get a ridiculous cloak for rangers Emerald Threaded Forest Cloak, lvl 45, 100% quality, 20% bonus, +9 dex, 6% cold/crush, +18 HP)
5. Speak with Torrance, at the guard tower on the road to innis. When you are ready, he will set you upon the next course. Just after the bridge jump off at the guard tower.
6. Talk to Asthore in Innis Carthaig about the [crystal]. She knew the merchant that was killed. (merchant shack next to the stable guy)
7. Talk to the locals of Alainn Binn about [Ysberin]. (See Lirla and say "Ysberin")

8. Madawg, a siabra magi, killed Ysberin. Go kill Madawg just north along the lake, rangers have it easy since it'll try to cast run cast, usually kill it before it gets to you. Yellow to lvl 50. 47.5k, 12.3k Sometimes has blue con saibra as guard, instant spawn I think.
9. Bring the staff to Lovenios. (go back to TNN =p lotsa travel).
10. Speak to Brigit, in the palace in Tir na Nog, about ilisa.
11. Speak to Ilisa in Mag Mell. Deliver the letter to her. Don't lose it! It's from the Elven Court. Find out where she learned the enchantments.

12. Seek out Ainrebh in the Empyrean town of Caille. give him the gift from Ilisa, and find out more about the vile magic. Take horse towards Druim Cain and get off at Caille in the building is Ainrebh the enchanter.
13. Say Ilisa sent you. Just click on the hotlinks in the text dialog.

14. Find the hag Ainrebh spoke about. She roams the Bog of Cullen, and looks like one who is dead. Tell her you [need aid]. can be found at 42.2k, 17.1k near where you killed Madawg. Say "need aid" then "cronicorn" if needed. Kill cronicorn, Then return the Cronicorn horn to the Hag.
--Cronicorn can be found at 38k x 44k He often wanders out of the Siabra camp into the water.

--There are a couple cronicorn spawns. I found one at 40k, 33k in the bog. Purple to 50's with 2 purple siabra guards. The fight with cronicorn isn't so bad, but there is a TON of agro in the area. Very dangerous spot.
15. kinda skips over by itself (Get nice Ranger's Jewel lvl 47, 100% quality, 25% bonus, +9 dex, +3 recurve bow, 21 HP)
16. Pay heed to the rantings of these Leprechauns. (Head to Cursed Forest near Druim Cain, 33.5k, 11.5k) Talk to them to make the step change or kill the named.

17. Go to the cursed Forest, and seek out the dancing leprechauns. (steps are goofy 16 and 17 is same thing basically, but kill Luriquay orange con at 50 at that locaiton, seems only 1 per person :( so full group kill it 8 times, spawn is roughly 15-20mins per just stay away from spawn camp and rock)
Jumps to step 20

20. See if a wraith by the name Flame roams the cursed forest. A big draon looking mob will spawn on the rock SW of where Luriquay spawns after you kill it. You will have to wait for full group to finish step 17 first :( Flame is near location 46.9k, 42k spotted at 20h 19m game time.... rumors it's a night spawn. Flame is neutral but attacks :( Purple con to lvl 50. Flame hits fast and for about 152-223dmg on avg against RI, along with nukes that does 258-268dmg
21. skips over fast to 22.
22. Find Green Maw somewhere on a hill in the remnants of a tower. After you kill Green Maw 2 more lower con merman types will spawn so watch out.
Flame is not a night spawn, it is neutral to anyone not on that step of the quest but is aggro if you are on the quest even though it says neutral so be careful.
After Flame check your steps, some may still be on 21 and not advanced to 22.. steps tend to skip for some reason. If you're on 21 go kill the leprechaun again.

Green Maw is inside the ruins of the tower on top of the granny hill, to make it show itself you have to get close to the tower and it will just attack you so just go rushing near to the tower and just fight. Be careful after you kill it, it will spawn 3 red cons then 4 or 5 orange cons after that and so on til 1 green con Green Maw.

Take key to Ainrebh the enchanter in Caille, give it to her and get a token, she tells you to make room in your bag (very very important or you won't get all your stuff) give the token back and you will get your 6 pieces of armor
Approximate loc of base of the hill for the Green Maw is 42k, 35k

after.Name: Traveler's Way -- Stones of Power
after.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: You are told to speak to a merchant in Humberton village, not the keep. He tells you to go kill a weakened demon behind the demon's tower in Camelot Hills. To get there, go to the bridge that connects Camelot Hills to Salisbury Plains. (The bridge is SE of Prydwen Keep, also SE of Camelot) Follow the bridge east, and away from the shore a tad to avoid aggressive mobs, and you should stumble upon the tower in a few seconds time. Encircle it, remembering to avoid the guards at the door, and you will find the weakend demon between the standing tower and the broken tower. Kill the demon and you will get the Demon Soul Gem (hidden eye), return to the merchant in Humberton, turn in the Demon Soul Gem.
This quest is a prerequisite for the level 11 Quest.
Rewards:
Svelte Hide Leggings -- Minstrel
Hidden Eye -- Wizard and Sorceror
Rewards:
Svelte Armor Leggings
Demon Soul Gem
